hints.title: Three-Node Binary Tree
hints.text: The tree is guaranteed to have exactly 3 nodes: root, root.left, and root.right.

hints.title: Child Sum Verification
hints.text: Compare root.val directly against the sum root.left.val + root.right.val.

hints.title: Boolean Result
hints.text: Return True if root.val == root.left.val + root.right.val, otherwise False.

hints.title: Direct Comparison Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct child value comparison takes constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate accesses left and right pointers directly without unnecessary recursion.
